raw.thesis: Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to tackle the pervasive problem of AI adoption and ROI measurement within AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: observing work patterns via desktop sensors, identifying high-ROI AI automation opportunities, and automatically generating and deploying AI agents through an "Agent Factory." This system doesn't aim to build new foundation models but instead leverages existing ones to create a "Work Graph," visualizing resource expenditure and pinpointing ideal AI intervention points. This allows for "Continuous AI lift" by addressing the lack of telemetry, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant system/human resource drift that enterprises typically face. The venture aims to provide a single, continuous system that observes, decides, and automates AI solutions, helping AI-first companies to effectively see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. This venture is positioned to complement existing AI solutions by providing the operational intelligence layer needed to maximize their effectiveness. It addresses a critical gap in the AI value chain: the ability to objectively measure and continuously improve AI's impact in real-world business processes. This makes it a foundational component for businesses looking to truly embrace an "AI-first" operational model.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited about solving the critical problem of enabling AI-first companies to achieve "Continuous AI lift" by providing a system that observes, decides, and automates AI solutions at scale.

core_insight.if_wrong: If enterprises cannot accurately observe and map their work processes, or if identifying high-ROI opportunities is not a systematic process, Narma's core value proposition of continuous AI lift will not materialize.
core_insight.why_different: Narma differentiates itself by providing an integrated system for continuous observation, AI opportunity identification, and automated agent deployment, focusing on a 'Work Graph' rather than developing new foundation models.

raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. It operates with a three-layered architecture: an Observe layer with lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, a second unspecified layer, and an Execution Layer. The Execution Layer features an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, including built-in approval gates. Narma leverages existing foundation models and focuses on creating a "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and optimal points for AI intervention.
